title: Trump teased an Iran deal that didn't come, but markets soared. Here’s why it keeps happening
summary_full: As oil reserves and munitions stockpiles reportedly dwindle, analysts wonder how much longer markets will pounce when the Trump admin. dangles an Iran deal.
